app.hr_employee.report_punch_approval_no: Your punch is submitted for your direct manager to review.
app.hr_employee.report_punch_break_clamp: Unpaid break clamped to {minutes} min — it cannot exceed the worked time.
app.hr_employee.report_punch_break_zeroe: Unpaid break set to zero because the worked time would not cover it.
app.hr_employee.report_punch_crosses_mid: Crosses midnight — the day shown is the local work date.
app.hr_employee.report_punch_description: Report a punch for {date}. The worked intervals and break are your statement of that day’s attendance.
app.hr_employee.report_punch_needs_times: Enter at least a clock-in time to preview and submit.
app.hr_employee.schedule_failed: Your schedule could not be loaded.
app.hr_employee.title: Employee Self-Service
app.hr_employee.header_description: Your schedule, leave, pay components, loans, payslips, and employment history in one place.
app.hr_employee.no_active_employment: No active employment on your record
app.hr_employee.no_active_employment_des: Time, leave, claims, loans, and payslips are all recorded against an employment, so there is nothing to show or submit until HR opens one for you. This is missing employment data, not a restriction on your access — ask HR to add your employment.
app.hr_employee.choose_employment: Choose the employment you are working in
app.hr_employee.choose_employment_descri: Your requests, time, loans, and payslips will be scoped to this employment.
app.hr_employee.search_employment: Search by company or employee number…
app.hr_employee.my_leave_description: Submit leave and track the approved request that directly updates payroll and balance.
app.hr_employee.leave_balances_descripti: Entitlement, earned, used, pending and remaining leave. As of {date}.
app.hr_employee.leave_balances_empty: No leave entitlement is configured for this employment.
app.hr_employee.leave_balances_pending_c: Pending leave reached the 2,000-request safety ceiling. Balances are hidden because the remaining amount cannot be calculated safely; ask HR to settle pending requests.
app.hr_employee.my_components_descriptio: Claims, allowances, arrears, and loan instalments, with why each entry exists.
app.hr_employee.my_loans_description: Loans still being repaid today: the agreed principal and the instalments it is being repaid by. Drop the effective-range filter for settled ones.
app.hr_employee.my_payslips_description: Review payroll results and a safe explanation of every line.
app.hr_controller.title: HR Controller
app.loans.title: Loans
app.loans.header_description: Repayment agreements deduct a principal over time — scoped to one legal entity. Outstanding is derived from scheduled instalments linked to payslips, never stored separately.
app.loans.empty: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.loans.agreements_description: Outstanding falls as paid runs recover instalments against the obligation.
app.pay_components.title: Pay components
app.pay_components.header_description: The single entry stream money reaches payroll through, scoped to one legal entity: claims, allowances, bonuses, arrears and corrections. A live entry is one with no open approval; there is no separate requested/approved state. The catalogue is configured in Settings.
app.pay_components.empty_entries: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.payroll.title: Payroll
app.payroll.header_description: Create a payroll run for a company period, resolve calculation blockers, then review and export employee results — scoped to one legal entity.
app.payroll.empty_overview: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.payroll.empty_runs: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.payroll.payroll_cycles_description: A period pays on its last day; a semi-monthly company pays each half on the 15th and at month end. Late means the pay date passed without a paid run.
app.payroll.no_open_cycles: No payroll cycles. Choose a legal entity to see its pay dates.
app.payroll.runs_description: Review payslips against their shared run-level policy snapshot, reconcile totals, export, and pay.
app.payroll.export_bank_files_descriptio: Download bank instructions from stored payslips and the effective employment bank details.
app.payroll.export_bank_files_error: The selected payroll has no bank payments to download.
app.payroll.export_payslip_pdfs_descript: Download employee payslips for any selected run with built results.
app.payroll.export_pdfs_error: The selected payroll runs do not contain built payslips yet.
app.payroll.export_workbook_description: Download the clean Infotech-style salary listing and complete breakdown.
app.people.title: People
app.people.header_description: Facts about the human being stay on the person; engagements, dated terms and statutory registrations hang off the employment and are read from that person's profile — scoped to one legal entity.
app.people.empty_overview: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.people.empty_trend: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.people.empty_profiles: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.people.workforce_description: Current status is derived from effective employments, not a duplicated employee flag.
app.people.chart_description: Monthly leavers and joiners against average headcount.
app.people.profiles_description: People whose employment is in force today; drop the employment filter for past staff. Open a person for their employments, contractual terms and statutory registrations — everything job-shaped hangs off the engagement, not off the human being.
app.scheduling.import_attendance_descrip: Import clock records into {month} from a time-clock export — one legal entity, one month, a person per row and a day per column.
app.scheduling.title: Scheduling
app.scheduling.header_description: Plan shifts and see who actually turned up, on the same calendar.
app.scheduling.import_title: Import planned assignments into {month} from the roster template — one legal entity, one month, a person per row and a day per column.
app.scheduling.people_need_shifts: {count} people have neither a pattern nor roster rows
app.scheduling.days_assigned: {rostered} of {total} days carry a roster override
app.scheduling.help_published: Every cell paints three layers: the base the shift pattern projects (muted, dashed), a roster override (solid, corner mark) and the time entries (bar, clock, or AWOL in red for an empty row on a work day). Click a cell to assign a shift, record attendance or swap two days on any unlocked day. Locked columns are days a paid payroll run settled.
app.scheduling.empty_board: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.scheduling.board_load_failed: The {month} board could not be loaded.
app.scheduling.no_matches: No people match the current search or filters.
app.scheduling.no_company_employments: This company has no employment records.
app.scheduling.empty_shifts: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.scheduling.shift_intro: A roster code is either WORK, REST or OFF. A WORK code carries its start, end and unpaid break; crossing midnight is derived from those times. Public holidays are overlaid from the observed holiday calendar and overtime is always calculated from schedule plus attendance.
app.scheduling.empty_patterns: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.scheduling.pattern_intro: A shift pattern is the base an employment projects its days from: a repeating cycle of roster codes from an anchor date (2 on 2 off, 2 mornings 2 nights, monthly day and night phases), or a rostered expectation for people assigned roster by roster. Employment terms point at one pattern; a roster row overrides one day of it.
app.scheduling.empty_holidays: No in-force legal entity. Choose a legal entity.
app.settings.title: Settings
app.settings.header_description: The jurisdiction settings of one lineage: sealed versions shared by every entity bound to it, each owning the payroll rules, the schemes and their rate bands, the leave types, the pay components and the holiday calendar. Drafts are edited; sealing freezes a version and everything under it; a change of law is a new version. Per-person registrations live under People.
component.name: Name
component.leave_half_hint: Tap a day for the whole shift. Top of a cell is the first half; bottom is the second — shift halves, not AM/PM.
component.leave_picker_disabled_no_emplo: Select an employment before choosing dates.
component.leave_picker_disabled_no_leave: Select a leave type before choosing dates.
component.excluded_leave_unavailable: No leave entitlement covers this date
component.excluded_before_hire: Before the employment hire date — not charged
component.excluded_after_exit: After the employment exit date — not charged
component.leave_balance_limit_reached: This selection exceeds the available {days} day(s).
component.excluded_other_leave: Another leave request covers this day
component.lock_pending_approval: System lock — this record is awaiting approval until the request closes.
component.lock_date_passed: {date} has already passed, so this record can no longer be edited directly.
component.lock_settled: {date} is inside paid payroll {period}, which has already priced that day. A new record cannot appear on a paid day — correct it with an adjustment entry in a later draft run.
component.lock_settled_by_run: Payroll {period} has already taken this record into account. Delete that run to release it while it is still a draft, or correct it with an adjustment entry once it has been paid.
component.leave_no_chargeable_days: Select at least one scheduled work half-day.
component.leave_pick_range_first: Pick the leave days on the calendar.
component.loan_schedule_imbalance: Schedule totals {due}; principal is {principal}. Submission is blocked until they match.
component.must_be_listed_on_contribution: Must be listed on the contribution
component.why_out_of_scope: Why this employment is out of scope
component.level_organisation_description: Company policy, for everyone it covers
component.choose_arrangement: Choose whose arrangement this layer is
component.authority_placeholder: The statute, clause or policy this layer comes from
component.cannot_delete: Payroll runs cannot be deleted in this workspace.
component.cannot_delete_paid: Paid payroll runs cannot be deleted. Correct them with a later draft instead.
component.delete_draft_description: Only draft payroll runs can be deleted. Paid runs stay on the record.
component.draft_built_nothing: This draft has no payslips. A run that is refused still leaves its record behind, so an empty draft is usually a refused build rather than a payroll with nobody in it. Delete the draft and create it again to see why.
component.payslips_description: Open a payslip for its direct component and statutory line breakdown.
component.employments_description: One row per company this person works for. hire_date drives service months and every leave accrual.
component.statutory_registrations_descri: Where each engagement stands with each statutory scheme — registered with a reference, or not registered with a reason.
component.statutory_contributions_descri: The schemes this version levies, in the order payroll applies them. Open one for the rate bands that price it; a band belongs to a scheme, not to the version.
component.ordinary_pay_note: Ordinary pay is divided by {divisor} {unit} a month. This is one version of a sealed, shareable settings lineage: a change of law enacts a new version, and sealing freezes this one with everything under it.
component.rate_bands_description: One rung of this scheme's ladder: the selector that picks it — wage, wage and age, headcount or risk class — and the award it pays. A floor is the first band, a ceiling the terminal one.
component.create_run_hint: Creating the run builds it: the payslips and their complete component lines are written before this closes.
component.risk_class_hint: The occupational risk group the entity is rated in, where its regime prices a contribution by risk. Indonesia's JKK is the one such scheme here: class {class_iv} is charged at 0.89% and class {class_i} at 0.24%, so an Indonesian entity left blank matches no band and its payroll run stops by name rather than quietly charging nothing. Malaysian and Philippine entities have no risk-keyed contribution and correctly leave this empty.
roster.day_sheet_break_clamped: Break reduced from {requested} to {applied} min — only {worked} min are recorded as worked, and an unpaid break must be shorter than that.
roster.day_sheet_cannot_save: The day cannot be saved with the current intervals.
roster.day_sheet_no_facts: Nothing is recorded for this day.
roster.day_sheet_problem_break_too_long: Unpaid break must be shorter than the recorded worked time.
roster.day_sheet_problem_ends_before_sta: Each worked interval must end after it starts.
roster.day_sheet_problem_missing_start: Every worked interval needs a clock-in time.
roster.day_sheet_problem_no_intervals: Record at least one worked interval.
roster.day_sheet_problem_open_not_last: Only the final worked interval may still be open.
roster.day_sheet_problem_out_of_order: Worked intervals must be in time order and cannot overlap.
roster.day_sheet_absent_description: On a scheduled work day with no covering leave or holiday, this costs one day's pay. On a rest or off day, a holiday, or under approved leave it is a no-op. Use Clear attendance to return this day to unrecorded.
roster.day_sheet_report_missing_punch_he: No clock-in recorded — report the punch for manager review.
roster.day_sheet_save_failed: The person-day could not be saved.
roster.day_sheet_unrecorded_attendance: Nobody has recorded attendance for this day.
roster.swap_armed: Swap armed — choose the second day.
roster.swap_failed_pair: One of the two days could not be assigned.
roster.swap_hint: Select a day to swap, then select the day to swap it with.
roster.swap_note: Swapping exchanges the roster codes of the two days.
roster.swap_refused_locked: The day is locked and cannot be swapped.
roster.swap_refused_unknown: The swap could not be completed.
roster.unrostered_monthly: No shift assigned. This person is on a monthly roster, so every day must be assigned here.
roster.unrostered_pattern: No shift assigned. Their repeating schedule does not cover this day.
roster.unrostered_no_pattern: No shift assigned. This employment points at no shift pattern, so nothing is projected.
roster.attendance_open: Clocked in, not yet clocked out
roster.no_attendance: No attendance override — scheduled hours apply
roster.no_attendance_in_pay_period: No attendance override — payroll assumes the scheduled hours; record AWOL if absent
roster.overlapping_shift_description: {first} overlaps {second}. Change the roster code or the adjacent day before saving.
roster.legend_attention: Needs attention — ! no clock-in, ⧗ clock still running
roster.legend_locked: Locked by payroll — open the day to see which run
roster.layer_awol: AWOL: reviewed, nothing worked on a work day
roster.layer_empty: Reviewed, nothing worked (not a work day)
roster.layer_none: No time entries: the plan is taken as worked
roster.planned_ot: Planned overtime (work over a rest, off or holiday day)
roster.conflict_pending_leave: Pending leave overlaps an assigned shift
roster.conflict_leave_work: Approved leave overlaps work on this day
roster.no_employments: No employments on this company in this month.
renderer.leave_payroll_effect.kind_unpai: Deducted through a named pay component
renderer.leave_payroll_effect.choose_com: Choose the component that carries the lost wage
component.workbook_browser_only: A workbook can only be chosen in a browser.
component.workbook_not_spreadsheet: "{file}" could not be opened as a spreadsheet.
component.workbook_save_as: Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
component.payslip_adjustments_descriptio: Everything caused by exactly one input — an obligation, a person-day or a leave request. A zero amount means the run read the source and it produced nothing.
component.payslip_base_description: Base earnings after any joining, leaving or salary-change proration. The calculation below explains these earnings.
component.payslip_base_none: No contracted amount on this payslip.
component.payslip_proration_description: These amounts are already included in base earnings. Each segment shows its dates, payable days and share of the contract salary.
component.payslip_statutory_description: Calculated from base and proration, not from any input. Employee and employer are two numbers on one charge.
component.work_day_actual_description: What was recorded as worked. Empty means nobody has recorded attendance for this day; overtime is derived from these intervals, the schedule and the statutory rules, never typed in.
component.work_day_planned_description: The roster code assigned for this day, and where the assignment came from. Absent when the day carries no plan of its own and the work pattern decides it.
renderer.leave_entitlement.empty: No entitlement layers — this leave type grants nothing until one is added.
renderer.component_definition.empty: No cap layers — the schema requires at least one before this saves.
renderer.payslip_base.identity: The contracted amounts this payslip starts from.
renderer.payslip_proration.identity: One segment per period the calendar split, with every input to the arithmetic beside its result.
renderer.payslip_statutory.identity: One row per scheme charged, with what it took from the employee and what it cost the employer.
component.event_allowance_hint: Repeats every pay period until it is ended.
component.event_description: What the entry pays and when it takes effect. A recurring allowance owns a period; a claim or bonus settles on its own date.
component.event_select_kind: What kind of entry is this?
app.kiosk.title: Attendance Kiosk
kiosk.title: Attendance kiosk
kiosk.ask_action: What would you like to do?
kiosk.ask_action_hint: Choose an action, then look at the camera.
kiosk.waiting_for_face_hint: Center one live face inside the guide, then blink once.
kiosk.countdown_detail: {action} in {seconds} seconds. Hold still and blink once.
kiosk.recording_detail: Keep facing the camera while the entry is saved.
kiosk.reading_face_detail: Keep facing the camera while your employee profile is matched.
kiosk.choose_action: Choose check in or check out
kiosk.choose_action_detail: Face scanning starts after you choose.
kiosk.unknown_hint: No approved profile matches this face. Please ask HR.
kiosk.no_active_employment: This person is recognized but has no active employment to record attendance against.
kiosk.live_face_required_detail: No live blink was detected. Photos and screens cannot record attendance. Look at the camera and blink once.
kiosk.face_lost_detail: No attendance was recorded. Center your face and try again.
kiosk.already_in_detail: Your first check-in is already saved. Choose Check out when you leave.
kiosk.no_arrival_detail: Check in before recording a check-out for today.
kiosk.unchanged_detail: No new attendance time was saved.
kiosk.preparing_detail: Starting the camera and secure face matching…
kiosk.camera_help: Use HTTPS and allow camera access, then try again.
kiosk.engine_unavailable_detail: Face models did not load: {models}. Face scanning is off; use Manual entry, or reload the kiosk once the release has been checked.
kiosk.choose_to_start: Choose check in or check out to start
kiosk.move_closer: Move closer and face the camera
kiosk.move_closer_detail: A face is in frame but too small or unclear to read.
kiosk.no_face_detail: Step in front of the camera and look at it.
kiosk.manual_status: Search for an employee and record an explicit check-in or check-out.
kiosk.manual_description: Use this when a face cannot be read. Every entry records this kiosk device as its author.
payroll.frozen_hint: Inputs and calculations are frozen. Delete this draft to change its inputs. Mark it paid only after payment has been made.
payroll.payment_confirmation: Mark paid only after payment has been completed. This closes the payroll permanently.
component.leave_eligibility_not_met: The employment does not meet this leave type’s eligibility rules.
component.leave_certificate_required: Attach a certificate: this request exceeds the leave type’s certificate threshold.
app.leave.requests_description: Every application of this entity, with the balance it draws on. The catalogue lives under Settings, Leave types.
app.settings.leave_types_description: The leave catalogue of the chosen version. A statutory row is the law the entity operates under and a company-rule row its own policy; eligibility is one expression over the person, and an employee it excludes never receives an entitlement. Editable while the version is a draft.
component.eligibility_placeholder: Empty is everyone. Example: employee.gender == "FEMALE" && employment.service_months >= 3
app.settings.pay_components_description: The pay component catalogue of the chosen version. A statutory row is the law and a company-rule row the entity's own allowance or claim; the contribution treatments say what every scheme does with the money, and a scheme left undecided stops the run by name. Editable while the version is a draft.
app.pay_components.entries_description: Claims, allowances, bonuses, arrears and corrections raised against the catalogue, with the payroll capture that settled each. The catalogue itself is configured in Settings.
renderer.contribution_treatments.identit: One row per statutory scheme, by its code: how that scheme charges this component.
renderer.contribution_treatments.empty: No treatments yet. Payroll refuses to price this component until every scheme the settings version levies has a row.
component.ordinary_rate: Rate of pay: monthly wage ÷ divisor per day or hour
component.legal_entity_description: Identity, the jurisdiction settings lineage whose law payroll is calculated under, and the three payroll facts of the entity.
component.settings_lineage_hint: The jurisdiction settings code this entity operates under, such as MY or SG; an entity that forks the shared law takes its own code, such as SG-norbital. The version in force is picked per date from the lineage.
component.settings_sealed_note: This version is sealed: it and every row under it are read-only. A change of law is a new version; a wrong seal is voided.
component.settings_voided_note: This version is voided and no longer governs anything. Reason: {reason}
app.settings.holidays_description: The holiday calendar of the chosen version. A statutory row is a gazetted public holiday; a company-rule row is the entity's own closure. Drives the PUBLIC_HOLIDAY day type the overtime rules price.
app.settings.lineage_missing: Jurisdiction lineage {code} has no version yet. Create one.
face.title: Enroll face
face.description: {name}: the camera guides five short poses, then you record consent.
face.engine_unavailable: Face engine unavailable: {models} did not load.
face.guide_left: Turn your head a little to the left
face.guide_right: Now a little to the right
face.guide_up: Tilt your head up a little
face.review_description: Five captures become one averaged descriptor. Record that the person consents to face clocking.
face.upload_unavailable: File upload is unavailable in this shell.
face.saved: Face enrollment saved. This person can now clock in at the kiosk.
